finiteDecisions.title: Restore verifiable generated-catalog provenance without altering sealed criteria
finiteDecisions.impact: Generator stops before reconstructing outputs from current tracked freeze. This proves a reproducibility/provenance gap, not an installed database outage. Preserve frozen bytes and establish correct historical input/explicit transition in existing maintenance card.

finiteDecisions.title: Fence ordinary semantic facts when their known authoritative source becomes unavailable
finiteDecisions.impact: During a cached recall, source resolver can exclude erased/expired PG source while ordinary world/experience facts retain their derived text. Observation and typed-learning paths already reject absent sources. Existing projection test explicitly models erased/expired source but keeps recall unchanged. Limit repair to exact known source authority; distinguish genuinely imported legacy references and resolver failure; no household incident claimed.

finiteDecisions.title: Use current participant identity in private recent-conversation labels
finiteDecisions.impact: Every private ingress is labeled Jaap even when its exact scoped principal is a different verified participant. The query remains principal-scoped: no cross-person content leak demonstrated. Derive an authorized participant label or neutral label on existing context path; no new identity store.

generatedProvenance.provenance: Repo-owned byte-sealed design generator decodes and verifies bound embedded bytes; no third-party vendoring/license inference. STATE-01 records failed input pin reproduction.

semanticTraces.trace: Owner feedback appends to the original intent; recent_initiatives rereads latest PERSONAL_INITIATIVE_FEEDBACK for exact owner into bounded next-review context. Due attention preserves exact original source and cancels replaced/stopped choices. This demonstrates a later-use source route, not measured improved behavior.

Original typed spec/work_id and principal/audience are retained across leases, exact successors, progress timeline, owner/household listing and workboard. Stopped/ambiguous/received-awaiting-review remain distinct; explicit delivery selection does not silently change source ownership.

Raw capture chunks and local pages bind owner/hash/call; local data does not claim fresh external verification. Registered saved-artifact resolution and exact source outcomes are adapter-owned inputs. Reuse E3.2 B02/APP03; receipt text alone does not prove the requested outcome.
Design/continuous-development documents are retained source inputs and exact selected component workflows; existing timeline/outbox owns state. No second memory, planner or permanent agent added.
